dedupe_keys.name: database of tension lap splices and embedded bars

description: Database of Tension Lap Splices and Embedded Bars is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Andres Lepage, University of Kansas (ku.edu). This database compiles worldwide data of reinforced concrete beam specimens tested to evaluate the bond strength of straight reinforcing bars in tension. The test data were collected from 72 references published between 1955 and 2024. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (XLSX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-qsz0-aj58. Keywords: bond, deformed reinforcement, development length, high-strength concrete, high-strength reinforcement, reinforced concrete. Published 2023-12-11. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
